args.message: Revenue shares by region for orders with status 'ok'. North has the largest share at about 33.2%, followed by South at 31.6%, East at 20.2% and West at 14.6%. Orders whose customer has no known region make up about 0.4% and are listed under the null label. Regions come from orders → customers → regions.
